name: Question 8
problem:
The data below is taken from the table of values of the cumulative distribution function $Φ(z)$ for the standard normal distribution. Given that $Y∼N(8,{3}^{2}),$ compute $P(Y\ge 1.88).$ Use the table below and do not round your answer.

| $z$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,-2.2\,$ | $\,0.0129\,$ | $\,0.0125\,$ | $\,0.0122\,$ |
| $\,-2.1\,$ | $\,0.0166\,$ | $\,0.0162\,$ | $\,0.0158\,$ |
| $\,-2.0\,$ | $\,0.0212\,$ | $\,0.0207\,$ | $\,0.0202\,$ |

$P(Y\ge 1.88)=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Given a normal random variable $Y∼N(\mu ,{\sigma }^{2}),$ we have

$$
P(Y\ge y)=P(Z\ge \frac{y-\mu }{\sigma })
$$

where $Z∼N(0,1)$ is a standard normal random variable. In our case, we have $\mu =8$ and $\sigma =3.$

First, we transform $Y$ into a standard normal random variable $Z$ by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Y\ge 1.88) & =P(Z\ge \frac{1.88-8}{3}) \\  & =P(Z\ge -2.04).\end{aligned}
$$

The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14070250/assets/c12f91dda20714f4b97a061a52d760249c0f9d9ce5029343af3e4c216981f43d.png)

Now, we express the required probability in terms of $Φ(z):$

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Z\ge -2.04) & =1-P(Z<-2.04) \\  & =1-P(Z\le -2.04) \\  & =1-Φ(-2.04).\end{aligned}
$$

From the table, we know that

$$
Φ(-2.04)=0.0207.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Z\ge -2.04) & =1-Φ(-2.04) \\  & =1-0.0207 \\  & =0.9793.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we conclude that

$$
P(Y\ge 1.88)=0.9793.
$$

Given a normal random variable Y∼N(μ,σ2), we have P(Y≥y)=P(Z≥y−μσ) where Z∼N(0,1) is a standard normal random variable. In our case, we have μ=8 and σ=3.

First, we transform Y into a standard normal random variable Z by z-scoring: P(Y≥1.88)=P(Z≥1.88−83)=P(Z≥−2.04).

The required probability is represented by the area shown below.

Now, we express the required probability in terms of Φ(z): P(Z≥−2.04)=1−P(Z<−2.04)=1−P(Z≤−2.04)=1−Φ(−2.04).

From the table, we know that Φ(−2.04)=0.0207.

Therefore, we have P(Z≥−2.04)=1−Φ(−2.04)=1−0.0207=0.9793.
